title: 'Looksmaxxing' influencer known as 'Clavicular' is charged with rape
subhed: Braden Peters, the 20-year-old internet personality known for promoting the 'looksmaxxing' trend on social media, has been charged with raping a 17-year-old girl who was heavily intoxicated in May 2025.
